stem: Large packets of rice are packed in cartons, each containing 20 randomly chosen packets. The masses of these packets are normally distributed with mean 1010 g and standard deviation 3.4 g. The masses of the cartons, when empty, are independently normally distributed with mean 50 g and standard deviation 2.0 g.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the variance of the masses of full cartons.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Small packets of rice are packed in boxes. The total masses of full boxes are normally distributed with mean 6730 g and standard deviation 15.0 g. The masses of the boxes and cartons are distributed independently of each other.
parts.text: Find the probability that the mass of a randomly chosen full carton is more than three times the mass of a randomly chosen full box.
